info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Plans-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Plans Retrieval API allows users to obtain a comprehensive list of available utility billing plans. This endpoint is designed for utility providers and developers seeking to integrate billing solutions into their applications. By querying this API, consumers can access detailed information about the various billing options, including pricing and features, enhancing their ability to manage customer accounts effectively. Typical use cases include displaying billing plan options for customers, enabling selection during onboarding, and supporting account management functionalities.

get.description: Fetches the details of the current billing plan associated with the account. This includes information such as the plan type, pricing, and any active features or limitations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the billing plan. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included to get accurate results.

ListUtilityBillingPlansRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body for the GET operation on the billing plan. It is expressed as a string.
